Working mode

A periodic review of the dev cycle itself (PREVENTION.md, DECISIONS 2026-11-23 "a periodic review of the cycle", and "a look-ahead every two or three phases")
A roadmap page for the maintainer (DECISIONS 2026-11-23 "the worklog stays Markdown, and a roadmap page is generated from it"), in three steps
scripts/roadmap.py writing docs/maintainer/roadmap.html from this file (the Now block as cards, the open items as Now, Next and Later columns, recent closes, the open issues' count), regenerated by commit.py whenever this file is committed; a sample for the maintainer's look before it is wired in; SWE-2
the Issues section audited (each open issue checked against today's code: closed, kept, or made a step) and its resolved entries pruned; whether it then moves to a file of its own is decided after
The call mutant kind's backfill (DECISIONS 2026-11-23 "a call extra mutant kind")
A mutation tier between mutants-diff and whole-crate runs (DECISIONS 2026-11-23 "a tier between mutants-diff and whole-crate runs"), built after the call backfill's measurements and before 1.0.0's first phase close, in slices
the extra kinds take a diff (extra_mutants.py keeps a mutant only on a changed line), and mutants-diff runs them, so the review loops test call mutants too;
a tracked record of each crate's last triaged whole-run commit, and the closure run
whole-crate runs as a rolling job on the VPS, the crate checked longest ago first; RUNBOOK "Phases and releases" and CONTRIBUTING "Mutation runs" rewritten to match.
Evaluate running only the tests that cover each mutant (the maintainer, 2026-11-23: worth a look, since it could cut a mutant's cost tenfold)
